title: Harborline Reseller Programme Schedule: Renewal Rate on the Lapsed Year of Domain Registrations
content:
## Reseller programme schedule — lapsed-year renewals

For a grace-period renewal of Domain Registrations billed on or after 1 December 2025, the lapsed-year reseller discount is the domain renewal discount percentage that Harborline Customer Accounts sets for the customer's account tier. It is the percentage discount that applies to the renewal price of the lapsed year: a Harborline Reseller Platinum account takes the Platinum percentage, a Harborline Reseller Gold account the Gold percentage, a Harborline Reseller Silver account the Silver percentage, a Harborline Reseller Bronze account the Bronze percentage, and every other account none.

| Account tier on the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts record | Lapsed-year reseller discount on the renewal price |
|---|---|
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | the domain renewal discount percentage of the Platinum tier |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | the domain renewal discount percentage of the Gold tier |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | the domain renewal discount percentage of the Silver tier |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | the domain renewal discount percentage of the Bronze tier |
| Any other account, such as a Harborline Personal Account or a Harborline Business Account | none |

### Points of application

- The tier read is the one the customer's Harborline account carries on its own record; the percentage itself is the figure the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for that tier, and it is not restated in this schedule.
- One account holds one tier, so exactly one row of the table applies to any renewal.
- The discount reduces the renewal price of the lapsed year only; it never touches the ICANN fee.

### Hypothetical cases

| Account on record | Discount on the lapsed year's renewal price |
|---|---|
| A Harborline Reseller Gold account | the Gold tier's domain renewal discount percentage |
| A Harborline Business Account | none |
| A Harborline Reseller Bronze account | the Bronze tier's domain renewal discount percentage |
